diagnosis: A fresh GUIDE_RESCATE candidate carried an explicit CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED receipt as actionable evidence even though EFF016B requires explicit connector denials to remain telemetry-only. The allocator filter currently recognizes reason/outcome, while the fresh receipt exposed classification without reason/outcome, so schema alias drift bypassed the filter.
intervention: Hardened the existing no-allocation receipt owner so future CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED receipts must project top-level reason=CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED in addition to transport_boundary_v1.classification, preserving current EFF016B consumer compatibility. Ratcheted claim_transport_boundary_contract_v1 for that compatibility law. Materialized one semantic-deduped follow-up repair for the allocator itself to normalize reason/outcome/classification/nested transport_boundary_v1.classification, covering historical and mixed producer shapes without backfill.

tests.name: claim_transport_boundary_contract_v1
tests.detail: Regression now asserts EFF016B canonical_reason compatibility plus nested transport classification owner.

remaining_boundary: The current allocator still needs the bounded compatibility repair to recognize historical classification-only receipts; that work is now one deduped claimable owner rather than another generic rescate loop.
